tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL TERMS AND CONDITION AS PER TENDER BID DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Previous supplies : The documents/ delivery note/Performa invoices for having supplied a minimum 3000 litres capacity of water tanker through "Tanker Supply" to the Govt. departments/Private Companies/PR Institutions in the past year.
Technical bid documents in Annexure I to VI AS PER BID DOCUMENT

Stock declaration: Copy of self declaration for having a minimum of 3000 litres capacity Tankers 15 nos, 5000 litres capacity Tankers 05 nos, 9000 litres capacity Tankers 03 nos in stock with him while applying for E Tender with details. Details to be filled in Annexure 09.

Annual turnover- To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer in its name should have in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 along with UDIN. Achieved in at least two financial years a minimum financial turnover of Rs.66.58 Lakhs.
